end.summary:
• Discussed unity in diversity using language, food, clothing, festivals, stories, and regional customs.
• Explained that different cultures add variety and shared identity, using the flower-garland example.
• Compared Lohri and Pongal, and dosa and chilla, identifying similarities and differences.
• Identified shared ideas in harvest festivals and epics retold in different languages.
• Teach-back was not passed; no misconceptions were recorded.
end.parentNote: Riya practised explaining how different languages, foods, clothes, festivals, and stories can share common threads. They used examples such as a flower garland, Lohri and Pongal, dosa and chilla, and the Ramayana in different languages. When comparing examples, some details needed checking, but they later identified shared seasonal ideas and common features. At home, ask them to make a small Venn diagram comparing two festivals or foods.
